subject: Botany
question_text:
Match List I with List II :

| List-I | List-II |
| :--- | :--- |
| A. Productivity | I. Gross primary productivity minus respiration losses |
| B. Net primary productivity | II. Rate of formation of new organic matter by consumers |
| C. Gross primary productivity | III. Rate of biomass production |
| D. Secondary productivity | IV. Rate of production of organic matter during photosynthesis |

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
explanation:
• **Productivity**: Rate of biomass production (A-III).
• **Net primary productivity (NPP)**: Gross primary productivity minus respiration losses ($NPP = GPP - R$) (B-I).
• **Gross primary productivity (GPP)**: Rate of production of organic matter during photosynthesis (C-IV).
• **Secondary productivity**: Rate of formation of new organic matter by consumers (D-II).
Hence, the correct match is **A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II**.

subject: Botany
question_text:
Match List I with List II:

| List-I | List-II (Activity) |
| :--- | :--- |
| A. Decomposition | III. Breaking down of complex organic matter into inorganic substances. |
| B. Detritus | IV. Dead remains of plants and animals including fecal matter |
| C. Mineralisation | II. Release of inorganic nutrients by the activity of microbes in soil |
| D. Humification | I. Accumulation of dark coloured amorphous colloidal substance |

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
explanation:
• **Decomposition**: Breaking down of complex organic matter into inorganic substances like $\text{CO}_2$, water, and nutrients (A-III).
• **Detritus**: Raw material for decomposition comprising dead plant and animal remains including fecal matter (B-IV).
• **Mineralisation**: Release of inorganic nutrients by microbial activity in soil (C-II).
• **Humification**: Accumulation of dark coloured amorphous colloidal substance called humus (D-I).
Hence, the correct match is **A-III, B-IV, C-II, D-I**.

question_text:

| List - I | List - II |
| :--- | :--- |
| (A) Hydrarch succession | (IV) Phytoplankton to mesic conditions |
| (B) Xerarch succession | (III) Lichens to mesic conditions |
| (C) Ecological succession | (I) Gradual change in the species composition |
| (D) Secondary succession | (II) Faster and climax reached quickly |

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
explanation:
• **Hydrarch succession**: Takes place in wet areas from phytoplankton to climax mesic condition: (A)-(IV)
• **Xerarch succession**: Takes place in dry areas starting with crustose lichens to mesic conditions: (B)-(III)
• **Ecological succession**: Gradual and predictable change in species composition: (C)-(I)
• **Secondary succession**: Begins in areas where natural vegetation was destroyed, progressing much faster to climax: (D)-(II)
Hence, the correct match is **(A)-(IV), (B)-(III), (C)-(I), (D)-(II)**.

question_text:
In which of the following both pairs have correct combination?

| Option | Gaseous nutrient cycle | Sedimentary nutrient cycle |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| (A) | Carbon and Sulphur | Nitrogen and Phosphorus |
| (B) | Sulphur and Phosphorus | Carbon and Nitrogen |
| (C) | Nitrogen and Sulphur | Carbon and Phosphorus |
| (D) | Carbon and Nitrogen | Sulphur and Phosphorus |
options: Gaseous: Carbon & Sulphur; Sedimentary: Nitrogen & Phosphorus
Gaseous: Sulphur & Phosphorus; Sedimentary: Carbon & Nitrogen
Gaseous: Nitrogen & Sulphur; Sedimentary: Carbon & Phosphorus
Gaseous: Carbon & Nitrogen; Sedimentary: Sulphur & Phosphorus
explanation:
• **Gaseous nutrient cycles**: The reservoir pool is the atmosphere or hydrosphere (e.g., **Carbon**, **Nitrogen**).
• **Sedimentary nutrient cycles**: The reservoir pool is Earth's crust (lithosphere) (e.g., **Phosphorus**, **Sulphur**).
Therefore, option (D) is the correct combination.

subject: Botany
question_text: Given below is a simplified model of phosphorus cycling in a terrestrial ecosystem with four blanks (A-D). Identify the blanks.
options: A $\rightarrow$ Detritus, B $\rightarrow$ Rock minerals, C $\rightarrow$ Producers, D $\rightarrow$ Litter fall
A $\rightarrow$ Litter fall, B $\rightarrow$ Producers, C $\rightarrow$ Rock minerals, D $\rightarrow$ Detritus
A $\rightarrow$ Rock Minerals, B $\rightarrow$ Detritus, C $\rightarrow$ Litter fall, D $\rightarrow$ Producers
A $\rightarrow$ Producers, B $\rightarrow$ Litter fall, C $\rightarrow$ Rock minerals, D $\rightarrow$ Detritus
explanation:
In the phosphorus cycle model:
• C represents Producers (which take up dissolved phosphate from soil solution).
• D represents plant litter fall adding organic matter.
• A represents Detritus (dead organic matter from producers and consumers).
• B represents Rock minerals (which undergo weathering and release phosphate into soil solution).
Hence, option (A) is correct.
